stage0700_01:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I level every unit evenly in SRW.」

stage0700_01:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I lose sleep choosing team pairings!」

stage0700_01:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What am I supposed to do...!?」

stage0700_01:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Nice work!
　Now let's go take the best kind of break, just you and me!」

stage0700_01:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Obviously!
　What every man's soul yearns for...! It's digging holes...」

stage0700_01:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I sealed $$アンディ$$ and his evil space!」

stage0700_01:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't go killing me without asking!」

stage0700_01:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Friend... Speak to players on break.」

stage0700_01:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Your job. Play your best violin.」

stage0700_01:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... Praise my sound, then air it.」

stage0700_01:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Silence!
　Besides, no one would be glad to see
　the two of us out here anyway!」

stage0700_01:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Doesn't seem that way, does it?」

stage0700_01:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「$$シュレード$$-$$カイエン$$... dizzy, nosebleed!」

stage0700_01:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This is hardly a break at all!」

stage0700_01:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What, quitting on me already?
　Tch, what a wimp...」

stage0700_01:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Men till dawn, women all night...?」

stage0700_01:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Fine. Save the fun for next fight.」

stage0700_01:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$不動$$... I'll take a break as well.」

stage0700_01:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$不動$$
「How about a donut for a sugar fix?」

stage0700_01:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$クレア$$
「A donut...?
　Where would such a thing even be?」

stage0700_01:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$クレア$$
「...You expect that to convince me?」

stage0700_01:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$不動$$
「Heh... Players agree too. See you!」

stage0700_01:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Hey there, customer! I've got some great shots!
　Want one? Anything catch your eye?」

stage0700_01:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「$$ミコノ$$? $$ゼシカ$$? $$ＭＩＸ$$?
　I've got $$ユノハ$$, Chairwoman $$クレア$$, and Instructor $$スオミ$$ too!」

stage0700_01:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Or maybe you'd rather have... me?」

stage0700_01:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Kidding. I wish someone saw only me!」

stage0700_01:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Done already? Pity. I wanted more.」

stage0700_01:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「One favor: max funds, hidden units.」

stage0700_01:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Very well then.
　I suppose granting your wish will wait for another time.
　Until then...」

stage0700_01:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Mallooooy! Mallooooy!
　And for good measure, Mallooooy!
　One more, Mallooooy!」

stage0700_01:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「W-What are you doing, $$モロイ$$?」

stage0700_01:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Crush study and work - keep playing!」

stage0700_01:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Then I'll corrode the player's will!」

stage0700_01:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Heh heh heh...! Heh heh heh heh heh」

stage0700_01:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Heh heh heh! Heh heh heh heh heh!」

stage0700_01:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「So you're taking a break too, everyone?
　I'm looking forward to seeing you all again.」

stage0700_01:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Um, uh... $$ミコノ$$...!
　If you're free, would you like to go to a movie during the break?」

stage0700_01:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「OK! Then let's all go together!」

stage0700_01:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...I'm tired, so I'll sit this out.」

stage0700_01:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「So you're taking a break too, everyone?
　I'm looking forward to seeing you all again.」

stage0700_01:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Um, uh... $$ミコノ$$...!
　If you're free, would you like to go to a movie during the break?」

stage0700_01:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「OK! Then let's all go together!」

stage0700_01:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Sorry, $$ゼシカ$$. Just $$ミコノ$$ and me.」

stage0700_01:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Ahaha, I was just teasing, $$アマタ$$!
　Go have fun on your date with $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0700_01:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$, why are you here?」

stage0700_01:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Want to play SRW together now?」

stage0700_01:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「It's solo. Teach me if I get stuck.」

stage0700_01:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ジン$$
（Oh...
　Could it be... this fluttering feeling is... combining...?）

stage0700_01:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Great work! Rest up till next time.」

stage0700_01:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What kind of limp greeting was that!
　You got the guts to fight or not!?
　Show some real spirit!」

stage0700_01:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You said it, $$カグラ$$!
　Then you show us a proper greeting yourself!」

stage0700_01:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I can do it too if I try!」

stage0700_01:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Players! I... er, await your return!」

stage0700_01:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't be gone too long now!
　Toorah-lah-lah-lah-lah-lah-lah!」

stage0700_01:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, you're stopping here?
　Nice work. Okay, next it's my turn to...」

stage0700_01:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, Chidori. Bad data ruins sims.」

stage0700_01:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You just trashed the whole game!」

stage0700_01:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$宗介$$
「Hand it over. I'll set real stats-」

stage0700_01:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Polish your gun well before bed!」

stage0700_01:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You mean teeth, not the gun...」

stage0700_01:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's 'Valor'!
　What's the point if you don't crush the enemy bearing down on us!」

stage0700_01:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Rush in blind, get ten game overs!」

stage0700_01:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's fine!
　Way better than a captain who's no help in real operations!」

stage0700_01:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Argh! That's enough!
　Let's let Mr. Sagara decide!」

stage0700_01:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are you doing here, Sergeant?!」

stage0700_01:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sir! It is Super Robot Wars!」

stage0700_01:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Testarossa's your ace, Sergeant?」

stage0700_01:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$宗介$$
「As a submarine, the TDD-1 has trouble
　adapting to certain terrain...」

stage0700_01:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Is that an excuse?」

stage0700_01:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Prove no terrain can hinder them!」

stage0700_01:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「If you tell me that's not possible, Sergeant...
　I will stuff you into a torpedo tube
　and launch you out with 300 kilos of explosives!」

stage0700_01:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「I swear by God and Her Majesty the Queen,
　I will tear you limb from limb! Is that clear!!」

stage0700_01:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$マオ$$
「Whew, finally done, finally done!
　...Wait, what are you doing, $$宗介$$?」

stage0700_01:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$宗介$$
「Studying. I have a test coming up.
　1185, let's build... the Muromachi Shogunate.」

stage0700_01:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's Kamakura, dammit!
　You really think you'll pass like that?」

stage0700_01:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$宗介$$
「Japanese history is my weak point...」

stage0700_01:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Easy on games, and on studying too!」

stage0700_01:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Whoa! You look terrible, you know?
　Why not take a break with the player?」

stage0700_01:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't do that!
　As someone entrusted with everyone's lives,
　I must always plan the best strategy...」

stage0700_01:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「H-hey, wait, Melissa!
　Where are you touching!? That tickles!」

stage0700_01:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's it, that's the face!
　Scrunching your brow like that isn't cute at all, you know.」

stage0700_01:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Honestly! You could've just said 'take a break' normally!
　Fine, I will rest properly.」

stage0700_01:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$マオ$$
「Good, that's more like it!
　See you later, player!」

stage0700_01:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Resting when you can is vital duty.」

stage0700_01:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Get good rest, then come back here.」

stage0700_01:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$テッサ$$
「A request, not an order. I'll wait.」

stage0700_01:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What an awful look on your face...!
　Torn up about stopping the game? Can't decide?」

stage0700_01:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Where'd that saint-like face of yours go?
　What a letdown...」

stage0700_01:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Conflicted now? I'll remind you...」

stage0700_01:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You bet it all on Super Robot Wars!」

stage0700_01:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Come back. Let's continue, honeeey!」

stage0700_01:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ロックオン$$... You admitted yourself
　your aim's not as good as your brother's, right?
　So that makes me the No. 1 sniper... OK?」

stage0700_01:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「I may lose to my brother, not you.」

stage0700_01:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$青山$$
「No feuds. Target allies, not foes...」

stage0700_01:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ha ha! We think alike, don't we!」

stage0700_01:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「...Well then, shall we go sniping?」

stage0700_01:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$青山$$
「I'll go on ahead. See you, everyone!」

stage0700_01:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「A break? Good timing. Get some rest.」

stage0700_01:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$アル$$
「Rest needs calm nerves. Try a joke.」

stage0700_01:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アル$$
「Jokes warm rooms. Go on, Sergeant.」

stage0700_01:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アル$$
「Bring one next time. Stay tuned.」

stage0700_01:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So, how about a movie to unwind?」

stage0700_01:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm outta here, so cover for me with some excuse!
　See ya!」

stage0700_01:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Balance is key in games and in life.」

stage0700_01:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Too much is bad! I mean, baaad!」

stage0700_01:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ignore advice and overdo it: see?」

stage0700_01:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「And that wraps up Teacher $$ゲイツ$$'s Life Lecture!
　See you next week!」

stage0700_01:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$バサラ$$
「All of you! Listen to my song!!」

stage0700_01:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Good work, players! First, my vow.」

stage0700_01:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「3 sleepless days to beat my limits!」

stage0700_01:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'll put all my feelings into song!」

stage0700_01:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Here I go, 'I am $$ガムリン$$'!
　Whoaaaa! My song...!」

stage0700_01:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Oh, Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$!
　If you have a moment, there's something
　I'd like you to hear with the other players!」

stage0700_01:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I sang my resolve to change myself!」

stage0700_01:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Alright, here I go! 'I am $$ガムリン$$'!
　My song...!」

stage0700_01:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Listen to my song! ...Just kidding!」

stage0700_01:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$クラン$$
「Hmph! What, quitting already!?
　Same as ever, lacking in spirit!」

stage0700_01:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$クラン$$
「...But true, overdoing it won't do!
　Managing your condition is part of a pilot's job!」

stage0700_01:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$クラン$$
「Very well, break time is permitted!
　But I'll be resting right alongside you!」

stage0700_01:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$クラン$$
「I-it's not that I want to be with you,
　even a little, or anything like that!
　Good chance to teach you a soldier's creed...」

stage0700_01:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$クラン$$
「Rest now! Superior's order! Got it?!」

stage0700_01:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$アルト$$
「I never knew solitude felt lonely...」

stage0700_01:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「But the game has friends - you too.」

stage0700_01:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll wait to fly Z3 with you again!」

stage0700_01:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Nice flying, $$アルト$$. Our sky is grand.」

stage0700_01:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$アルト$$
「Beside you, I feel we're twin wings.」

stage0700_01:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Oh...? Then I am your wings?」

stage0700_01:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Hahahaha!
　Call it my answer to your romantic words.」

stage0700_01:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I'm a Virgo romantic. Shall I go on?」

stage0700_01:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アルト$$
「I-I think I'll pass, thank you!」

stage0700_01:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$レア・イグラー$$... Join my sins in Altea.」

stage0700_01:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just so you know, I'm a man!」

stage0700_01:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Beauty: no sex. Quit game; join sin.」

stage0700_01:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$アルト$$
「Y-you there...!
　Think of it as saving me and come right back
　to the game! Please! Hurry!」

stage0700_01:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Alright...!
　No one can interrupt my singing practice here!」

stage0700_01:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Here I go, 'I am $$ガムリン$$'!
　Hear my song!!」

stage0700_01:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「What? My song won't help you rest?」

stage0700_01:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I see! You're getting that fired up over me!
　Thank you, all you players!
　I look forward to seeing you again!」

stage0700_01:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ミサト$$'s job... Fine, I'll read.」

stage0700_01:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「At last, Rebuild of Evangelion joins the battle!」

stage0700_01:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$シンジ$$'s roped into Volunteer Club.」

stage0700_01:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Where will their fated tale lead?」

stage0700_01:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Read this? Understood. I'll do it.」

stage0700_01:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「EVA-00 thaws. What's next for life?」

stage0700_01:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ミサト$$
「New worlds, new foes, new allies.」

stage0700_01:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Where will this war take Shinji?」

stage0700_01:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Yeah... The original has real class.」

stage0700_01:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Hey, $$シンジ$$!
　You settled into the new surroundings yet?」

stage0700_01:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Not really. I don't like crowds...」

stage0700_01:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Still shy, huh? Then I'll do it!」

stage0700_01:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$トウジ$$
「I'll pilot the EVA and nail it!」

stage0700_01:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Oh, I hear that's not in this one.」

stage0700_01:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$トウジ$$
「What?! When we finally got to talk?!」

stage0700_01:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Duty fills my head, unlike yours.」

stage0700_01:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$加持$$
「A date if we had time... Too bad.」

stage0700_01:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$加持$$
「Don't pretend. I know how you sleep.」

stage0700_01:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「W-w-what are you talking about, you!
　And you too, quit listening in and pause already!」

stage0700_01:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$加持$$
「That's how it is. See you.」

stage0700_01:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$アスカ$$, done? Then lend me SRW!」

stage0700_01:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Is it fun to play with someone?」

stage0700_01:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Would they like me to play instead?」

stage0700_01:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$マリ$$
「Huh?
　You being here means you're pausing the game?」

stage0700_01:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$マリ$$
「Rest, come back. Promise? I'll wait.」

stage0700_01:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Ends... I wanted more SRW together.」

stage0700_01:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... Do my words trouble you?」

stage0700_01:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Even I want company some nights.」

stage0700_01:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I hope to fight beside you someday.」

stage0700_01:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Until next time, mighty players.」

stage0700_01:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Rest well first. One word of advice.」

stage0700_01:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Find a trusted ally or rival. Grow.」

stage0700_01:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll await your return in battle.」

stage0700_01:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Rest well first. I have good news.」

stage0700_01:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Play and find out. Until next time.」

stage0700_01:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$五飛$$, how many stages are left?」

stage0700_01:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How many more times do we have to continue...?
　$$ゼロ$$ won't tell me anything...
　Tell me, $$五飛$$.」

stage0700_01:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$五飛$$
「That's... going to happen all over again?」

stage0700_01:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$カトル$$
「Pausing the game? A wise choice.」

stage0700_01:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$カトル$$
「I'd never allow such a thing...」

stage0700_01:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$カトル$$
「Rest. Be yourself again. See you!」

stage0700_01:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Good job, $$バナージ$$. Enjoying SRW?」

stage0700_01:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I botch Unicorn's Destroy Mode...」

stage0700_01:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「How can I split Unicorn's horn...?」

stage0700_01:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ask Shin or $$キラ$$ for overhead tips.」

stage0700_01:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Who knows... You'll get it in time.」

stage0700_01:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$シャア$$
「Youthful mistakes are hard to admit.」

stage0700_01:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$シャア$$
「That man grew up, and he changed.」

stage0700_01:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$シャア$$
「I believe their passion saves Earth.」

stage0700_01:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$クェス$$
「Why pause now, right when it's getting good!
　Keep playing, you hear me!」

stage0700_01:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Don't push yourself, $$クェス$$. Rest up!」

stage0700_01:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Mine's the same. Health comes first!」

stage0700_01:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$クェス$$
「I see. That's another idea... Maybe!」

stage0700_01:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Let's say goodbye. See you again!」

stage0700_01:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$クェス$$
「Come back safely, okay? Promise me!」

stage0700_01:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$シン$$
「Pausing here, huh?
　Guess I'll take a break too.」

stage0700_01:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$シン$$
「Fight, rest, and always come back.」

stage0700_01:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$シン$$
「Together is our only way to peace.」

stage0700_01:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then it's over. The game's over.」

stage0700_01:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Only the player can decide to quit!」

stage0700_01:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Not over or cleared - only paused!」

stage0700_01:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Then I'll tell the players to rest.」

stage0700_01:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Save done. Quit the game, Captain?」

stage0700_01:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$オットー$$
「Player's call. Prepare for anything.」

stage0700_01:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$オットー$$
「War goes on. This is only a respite.」

stage0700_01:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$オットー$$
「Get some rest. I'm counting on you.」

stage0700_01:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Well fought. Your foe salutes you.」

stage0700_01:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No praise from a mortal foe, then?」

stage0700_01:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Good reflexes, but also reckless.」

stage0700_01:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I await our map duel, worthy rival.」

stage0700_01:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「By then, you'll know my true intent.」

stage0700_01:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$刹那$$
「War goes on, but peace lies ahead.」

stage0700_01:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$刹那$$
「Beat SRW Z3. I trust peace awaits.」

stage0700_01:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$刹那$$
「I'll fight with you. Till we meet.」

stage0700_01:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「...What's wrong?
　That's not like you, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0700_01:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I did it...
　I really did it! With everything I had!
　And this is what I get for it!」

stage0700_01:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Raise levels, kills, funds, Z Chips!」

stage0700_01:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What more do you want from me!?
　What am I even supposed to fight!?」

stage0700_01:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Aw, hell... We're in bad shape.」

stage0700_01:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Rest often. Don't end up like me.」

stage0700_01:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「You're quitting...?
　But you haven't even cleared the game yet...?」

stage0700_01:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Show me the pride of an SRW player.」

stage0700_01:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「If you have that kind of courage,
　come back and resume the game at once.」

stage0700_01:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$! You can't talk like that!
　It'll only corner other people, and yourself too!」

stage0700_01:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's rest. You're tired too.」

stage0700_01:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Hey there, player!
　So, that's how it is. We'll get out of your way now!」

stage0700_01:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I never knew unmasking felt so good.」

stage0700_01:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Shed past and mask. Free your heart.」

stage0700_01:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$シャア$$
「And so, new trials await them there.」

stage0700_01:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$グラハム$$
「But you mustn't be afraid of that.」

stage0700_01:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$シャア$$
「Meet again in Super Robot Wars Z3.」

stage0700_01:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Here I thought you were gone, and you're off playing games!」

stage0700_01:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Then let me share a useful tip!」

stage0700_01:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Save clear data. You'll need it!」

stage0700_01:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$くらら$$
「I see...! I'll keep that in mind!」

stage0700_01:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$朔哉$$
「How the heck do you know that!?」

stage0700_01:r_718d4f86b37b2915.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Sure! I read Monthly Men's SRW!」

stage0700_01:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That was another tough mission...」

stage0700_01:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$くらら$$
「If you ask me, the player must be
　the most exhausted of us all!」

stage0700_01:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$葵$$
「You're right! You've fought beside us all this time.
　Thank you...!」

stage0700_01:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Thanks for all your hard work!」

stage0700_01:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$くらら$$
「Make sure you get plenty of rest!」

stage0700_01:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You were on fire out there...!」

stage0700_01:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Welcome! I'd rather rest than fight.」

stage0700_01:r_cb789b091a7a05ca.text:
$$田中司令$$
「No, no, it's not that I'm slacking off, you know?
　Moderation in all things, that's the key. Yep.」

stage0700_01:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$田中司令$$
「One last job remains... Ready, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$?」

stage0700_01:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Ahem!
　Super Robot Wars Z3! Next time as well...!」

stage0700_01:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$さやか$$
「I saw you, $$甲児$$!
　Skipping training, what do you think you're doing!?」

stage0700_01:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$甲児$$
「I-I want to play SRW too!
　Cut me some slack, $$さやか$$!」

stage0700_01:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$さやか$$
「Fine, then... but I'm playing too.」

stage0700_01:r_722be3d36da4979c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Okay, $$さやか$$. SRW is solo play...」

stage0700_01:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's it!
　If I team up Mazinger and Venus,
　it'll feel like we're fighting together!」

stage0700_01:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Nice, $$甲児$$. Love drills paid off.」

stage0700_01:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$隼人$$
「You taught Koji? Such a novice...!」

stage0700_01:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$甲児$$
「Nice work! Calling it a day?
　Maybe I'll take a break too...」

stage0700_01:r_888c0b4c627ecec4.text:
$$シロー$$
「This is serious...!
　I'm so hungry my stomach's stuck to my back!」

stage0700_01:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$甲児$$
「Don't scare me like that...
　Well, since we're taking a break,
　I'll whip up something good to eat!」

stage0700_01:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$シロー$$
「Now you're talking!
　A guy who can cook! A three-star chef!
　I can't believe you don't have a girlfriend!」

stage0700_01:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$甲児$$
「What's that about not having a girlfriend!?
　That has nothing to do with this!
　Hey! Get back here, $$シロー$$!」

stage0700_01:r_58b16d8cc9b8a2a5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$號$$... Any words for the player?」

stage0700_01:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$號$$ waits for you, and so do I.」

stage0700_01:r_0e1caed2ba333f4e.text:
$$號$$
「Next time, on SRW Z3:
　'Purgatory!! The Endless Battle!'
　Switch that channel on!」

stage0700_01:r_1f65c397b9d1833d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Beat $$ガイオウ$$, now the world's a mess!」

stage0700_01:r_7aac40a4f34dcec3.text:
$$赤木$$
「Can a mere salaryman handle this!?」

stage0700_01:r_371b88cba6c82378.text:
$$赤木$$
「Next: SRW Z3 - The Sealed World!」

stage0700_01:r_160384a0c68215c6.text:
$$赤木$$
「Huh? We're stopping right here?
　I want to see what's next, let's keep playing, huh!」

stage0700_01:r_ee134f0fa96047a6.text:
$$赤木$$
「True, but use Spirit and Vigor!」

stage0700_01:r_c1cddb7853813703.text:
$$青山$$
「So I'll give you Bless and Cheer!」

stage0700_01:r_3569c3ca91ae0f9d.text:
$$赤木$$
「You had a command like that!?」

stage0700_01:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$青山$$
「Private use. Players, see you again!」

stage0700_01:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So we stop here for now?
　Then I, too, shall enjoy a brief respite.」

stage0700_01:r_f612b6b60810e300.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But you remain the hero of this story.
　No story exists without its hero.」

stage0700_01:r_09068a6fd74f79b7.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm still Roger. You stay the hero.」

stage0700_01:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Till next time in Super Robot Wars.」

stage0700_01:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Well done, players. I'll rest too.」

stage0700_01:r_402b4aaf0ee30986.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Me...?
　Shouldn't that be 'us', $$エンジェル$$?」

stage0700_01:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「I'm flattered by the invitation...
　but is that wise? A rather grumpy android
　is watching us.」

stage0700_01:r_b402ecf2db57f319.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「No, that's not it, that's not it at all!
　This isn't what it looks like! Listen to me, $$ドロシー#240$$!」

stage0700_01:r_adc5793509f8d46c.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Heh heh... Looks like $$ロジャー$$ will be busy for a while...
　Well then, shall we enjoy our rest, just the two of us?」

stage0700_01:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「We need rest, and a way to enjoy it.」

stage0700_01:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「R. Dorothy: black, no milk or sugar.」

stage0700_01:r_ee41ea400d1ee0bf.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Bitter coffee and sweet talk. Ideal.」

stage0700_01:r_eb56670c83981cc6.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「You really are the worst.」

stage0700_01:r_90b6cb0493a2982b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Human women tell me that often.」

stage0700_01:r_8d5dbaa0f1e069de.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$ニーバ$$, it's time to pause the game.」

stage0700_01:r_301d85713d2cddd7.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「It's also an order from above.」

stage0700_01:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「A soldier need only follow orders!」

stage0700_01:r_fa7a261c85f92c5a.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Too excited and fainted? Big oaf!」

stage0700_01:r_16141de28d738543.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Want his fate? Restrain yourselves!」

stage0700_01:r_f9ff2a77c392a048.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$, today you will fight me!」

stage0700_01:r_3167d694c10c96fb.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Bad timing. We always meet in chaos.」

stage0700_01:r_54e755252ec3acc4.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Heh, relax. Your paused SRW? Cleared」

stage0700_01:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Once more: don't interfere. Got it?」

stage0700_01:r_d7cd6f0e351ca403.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Naive... Under 10% can still hit!」

stage0700_01:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Go back to my last save? No, that won't do!
　Whatever I intend, time won't allow it.」

stage0700_01:r_912c58272c320559.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「The time limit's already passed...
　there's no time left to turn back...!
　Then the answer I must choose is...!」

stage0700_01:r_49dde825db6b02a0.text:
$$カレン$$
「Um, well... thanks for playing.
　You'll come right back and keep going, right?
　Or else...」

stage0700_01:r_5d3ee1804aedfa48.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Hey, what kind of greeting was that?
　Far too stiff.
　And not a shred of charm, either.」

stage0700_01:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Then I'll show you my trump card...」

stage0700_01:r_0f9b6f684aa8f438.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Um, master...
　I'll do anything, so please come back soon!」

stage0700_01:r_7ff5aecfd0f37b20.text:
$$シモン$$
「Game over! Do that move, $$ヴィラル$$!」

stage0700_01:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
$$シモン$$
「Hope and despair, two roads before us!
　Twisting, crossing, our final battle!」

stage0700_01:r_0c472072ac8bda60.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Steel fist, keen mind - victory!」

stage0700_01:r_a378a46f62b5980d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Super Robots, united in flame!
　Super Robot Wars Z3!!」

stage0700_01:r_aeef429ff90ba18f.text:
$$シモン$$
「What do you think this game is?!」

stage0700_01:r_f0ce8e3e0d75533e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Same old thing, so I won't ask...」

stage0700_01:r_87e728176c45393f.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Nice work! Rest, then play again!」

stage0700_01:r_5c0f74cc35812a77.text:
$$シモン$$
「Game over! Do that move, $$ヴィラル$$!」

stage0700_01:r_8e1ebf6b0c149f4b.text:
$$シモン$$
「Hope and despair, two roads before us!
　Twisting, crossing, our final battle!」

stage0700_01:r_86f0e9b721a4f655.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Steel fist, keen mind - victory!」

stage0700_01:r_84158af5a79e4d35.text:
$$シモン$$
「Super Robots, united in flame!
　Super Robot Wars Z3!!」

stage0700_01:r_c42f7ca81fe0cf88.text:
$$シモン$$
「What do you think this game is?!」

stage0700_01:r_4c845bb8b05d3b13.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Same old thing, so I won't ask...」

stage0700_01:r_836fc0eae35929e9.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Nice work! Rest, then play again!」

stage0700_01:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「It's over alreadyyy!?
　We're just getting starteeeed!!」

stage0700_01:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$シモン$$
「What's gotten into you, $$アーテンボロー$$?
　You seem oddly fired up...」

stage0700_01:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Heh heh! Grown-up reasons held me back till now!
　But now I've got a face and a voice,
　so I'm a hundred times as fired up!」

stage0700_01:r_47c1edbfd5664fd7.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「I could replace $$ダヤッカ$$ as captain!」

stage0700_01:r_fbdb8764f80a1b12.text:
$$シモン$$
「Can $$アーテンボロー$$ do it?」

stage0700_01:r_bba76accfb31e66d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Right, $$アーテンボロー$$. Rest up.」

stage0700_01:r_199a6e6247ffb58b.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Nnngh!
　Well then, farewell!」

stage0700_01:r_48a06834bb510d7d.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「It's over alreadyyy!?
　We're just getting starteeeed!!」

stage0700_01:r_f19a063712278769.text:
$$シモン$$
「What's gotten into you, $$アーテンボロー$$?
　You seem oddly fired up...」

stage0700_01:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Heh heh! Grown-up reasons held me back till now!
　But now I've got a face and a voice,
　so I'm a hundred times as fired up!」

stage0700_01:r_90591ae4aa6d92d6.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「I could replace $$ダヤッカ$$ as captain!」

stage0700_01:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$シモン$$
「Can $$アーテンボロー$$ do it?」

stage0700_01:r_9520c4f160aa3ebd.text:
$$シモン$$
「Right, $$アーテンボロー$$. Rest up.」

stage0700_01:r_9dc3c6963e7dac77.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Nnngh!
　Well then, farewell!」

stage0700_01:r_7d5585f6d8b1df8d.text:
$$リーロン$$
「$$ロージェノム$$, thoughts on this game?」

stage0700_01:r_5933be40e8f9d954.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Games give desire form and worth.」
